# deps/install-script

New package with an install script.

A package that is new in the lockfile, directly or through another dependency, and runs a preinstall, install, or postinstall script (hasInstallScript in package-lock.json, requiresBuild in pnpm-lock.yaml).

- Default level: `warn`.
- Levels: Skipped when the project sets ignore-scripts=true in .npmrc, and for pnpm packages that onlyBuiltDependencies leaves out or neverBuiltDependencies and ignoredBuiltDependencies list.
- Looks at: what the change did, comparing each file before and after.
- References: [CWE-829](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/829.html), OWASP A03:2025.

## Why it matters

Install scripts run with your permissions when the package is installed, before any of its code is imported. The Shai-Hulud worms spread through install scripts in compromised packages.

## Flagged

`package-lock.json` (warn):

```json
"resolved": "https://registry.npmjs.org/@parcel/watcher/-/watcher-2.5.0.tgz",
```

`package-lock.json` (warn):

```json
"resolved": "https://registry.npmjs.org/fsevents/-/fsevents-1.2.13.tgz",
```

`package-lock.json` (warn):

```json
"resolved": "https://registry.npmjs.org/sharp/-/sharp-0.33.5.tgz",
```

`pnpm-lock.yaml` (warn):

```yaml
/@swc/core@1.9.3:
```

`pnpm-lock.yaml` (warn):

```yaml
/sharp@0.33.5:
```

`pnpm-lock.yaml` (warn):

```yaml
/esbuild@0.25.0:
```

## Not flagged

- `ignore-scripts=true` in `.npmrc`: npm and pnpm run no install scripts in this project, so new packages with scripts are not reported
- esbuild: a new version, but esbuild already ran its install script at the base
- bcrypt: on packages.allow in ubon.json
- left-pad, chokidar-cli, react: no install script
- esbuild: a new version of a package that already built at the base
- bufferutil: listed in pnpm.neverBuiltDependencies, so pnpm does not run its script
- left-pad and ws: no requiresBuild
- `onlyBuiltDependencies:` in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`: pnpm builds only esbuild; the script of sharp does not run, so sharp is not reported
- left-pad: no requiresBuild

## How to fix

Check what the script does (npm view <name>@<version> scripts) before installing; if it is expected, add the package to packages.allow in ubon.json.

## If the finding is wrong

Add a comment on the line above, in the comment syntax of the file, that says who decided and why:

```
ubon-ignore deps/install-script: <who decided>: <evidence>
```

Or turn the rule off for the project in `ubon.json`: `"rules": { "deps/install-script": "off" }`. See [configuration](../../config.md).
